summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and widens ControlCode to admit Tuple[ControlType, str]; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 format entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and the Control.title classmethod; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch calling term.set_title(title) for title controls; rich/console.py adds set_window_title gated only on is_terminal, returning True/False; CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200; tests added in test_console.py, test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only). Tests were not run, per instructions; all changes were verified by reading only. Nothing committed.
